source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
When a **BLOOD LEGIONS** or **WORLD EATERS** unit of yours destroys an enemy unit, you roll a D6: a 3+ earns you 1 BTP (Blood Tithe point). As each Command phase begins, yours or your opponent's, you may spend BTP to activate 1 of these abilities until the battle ends:

- **Enraged Abjuration [2BTP]**: your **BLOOD LEGIONS** and **WORLD EATERS** models have **[Feel No Pain 5+](vsdata:core-ability/feel-no-pain)** against **mortal wounds** and Psychic Attacks.
- **Daemonic Rage [3BTP]**: your **BLOOD LEGIONS** units' melee weapons have **[[LANCE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lance)**.
- **Boon of Blood [4BTP]**: a 4+ invulnerable save for your **BLOOD LEGIONS** units.
- **Might of Khorne [5BTP]**: your **BLOOD LEGIONS** units have [Blessings of Khorne](vsdata:ability/world-eaters.blessings-of-khorne).

earn.trigger: a friendly BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS unit destroys an enemy unit

spend.when: start of the Command phase (either player's; the text does not say 'your')
